reference: MetaTrader Android, EURUSD M1, USB-connected device
reviewMethod: Recorded device interactions; decoded MP4s with FFmpeg and visually inspected extracted contact sheets and full-resolution screenshots using view_image.

tradeSubmission.scope: Order-type selection, draft-line interaction, editor expansion/collapse and visibility only; no Place, Buy or Sell submission was tested.

commonPendingOrderBehavior.line: Solid horizontal line across the chart plot, colored blue for buy and red for sell.
commonPendingOrderBehavior.label: Uppercase order type followed by volume, placed just above the line at the plot's left edge.
commonPendingOrderBehavior.priceBadge: White-filled rectangular badge at the right price axis; border and price text match the line color.
commonPendingOrderBehavior.handle: Hollow circular drag ring at the horizontal midpoint of the plot, with matching outline.
commonPendingOrderBehavior.dragMagnifier: A circular magnifier with the draft's outline color appears near the upper-left chart area while dragging; the pending title and right-axis value remain visible.
commonPendingOrderBehavior.selection: Selected type is emphasized in its buy/sell color; other types are gray in a horizontally scrolling selector.

defaultEntry.observed: Selecting the six pending types produced an entry line near the visible plot's vertical midpoint, generally 1.12289 during the first recording. Initial Buy Limit was 1.12286; later reopening produced 1.12288.
defaultEntry.inference: The entry draft appears initialized from the chart viewport midpoint. The precise rounding and default formula are not proven by the recording.

dragAndSwitch.observed: Dragging the Sell Stop Limit entry ring downward moved its solid line and right-axis badge from 1.12289 to 1.12260. Switching afterward to Buy Stop Limit reset the entry to 1.12289.
dragAndSwitch.limits: Entry drag was directly tested on Sell Stop Limit; equivalent drag behavior for each other pending type was not independently tested.

stopLimitSecondary.appearance: Separate black solid line, black hollow midpoint ring, outlined right-axis price badge and STOP LIMIT PRICE label.
stopLimitSecondary.outsideViewport: When the secondary level is above the chart range, STOP LIMIT PRICE and an upward triangle appear at the plot's top-right edge.
stopLimitSecondary.observed: Both initial stop-limit selections showed the above-viewport indicator; the later Buy Stop Limit screenshot showed a visible black secondary level at 1.12359.
stopLimitSecondary.reason: The initial numeric secondary value is offscreen, and the recording does not establish how the later 1.12359 level was initialized or changed. Do not infer a fixed offset or side-dependent default from this sample.

panelLifecycle.entryPoint: Clock-like toolbar icon immediately after timeframe M1 opens or hides the chart order editor.
panelLifecycle.collapsed: Editor shows symbol, SL/TP buttons, right arrow, and horizontal order-type selector below the quote/volume strip.
panelLifecycle.hide: Hiding removes the editor and draft entry/secondary lines and restores bottom navigation; quote/volume strip remains.
panelLifecycle.reopenAfterPending: After hiding a pending-order editor, reopening showed Buy Limit with a fresh entry at 1.12288.
panelLifecycle.expanded: Expanding Buy Limit opens a taller sheet over a dimmed chart. Price field equals the draft line value 1.12288; sheet includes volume, Add Stop Levels, expiration, comment and Place Buy Limit.
panelLifecycle.market: Selecting Market Execution removes pending draft entry/secondary lines; normal live quote lines remain. Expanded market ticket has Sell and Buy actions, and collapsed selection is black.

limitations: MetaTrader connectivity dropped after screenshot 19; quotes and toolbar controls became gray. Market-to-hide-to-reopen behavior is therefore inconclusive and must not be treated as a successful reopen test.
No trade was submitted; broker acceptance, execution, and stop-limit API support were not verified.
Observed on one symbol, timeframe, volume and Android device; exact default-price formulas and behavior across other symbols or zoom levels remain unverified.
Reference SL/TP buttons were visible, but adding or dragging SL/TP levels was outside this recording's six-pending-order interaction coverage.
